question: How does the goddess protect and gladden the far-seeing one?
premises: The goddess has the nature of destroying the enemies of the far-seeing one.
The goddess makes the far-seeing one rejoice.
inference: She both removes threats to him and brings him joy.
uncertainties: Spelling varies between dūradarśśya- and dīrgghadarśi- as given in the tokens.
plain_english: She destroys the enemies of the far-seeing one and makes him rejoice.
